# Huawei
> Huawei is a global provider of ICT infrastructure, enterprise solutions, carrier technologies, cloud services, and consumer devices.

Huawei operates multiple major web properties across corporate, consumer, carrier, enterprise, and cloud domains. This file highlights the most useful documentation, product, solution, support, and insight pages for understanding Huawei’s offerings.

## Corporate
- [Huawei Global Homepage](https://www.huawei.com/en/): Corporate entry point for Huawei products, solutions, industries, and company information.
- [About Huawei](https://www.huawei.com/en/about-huawei): Overview of Huawei’s business, mission, leadership, and corporate profile.
- [Products](https://www.huawei.com/en/products): Top-level directory for Huawei product categories across business areas.
- [Industry Solutions](https://www.huawei.com/en/industry-insights): Industry-focused content, transformation themes, and solution overviews.
- [Newsroom](https://www.huawei.com/en/news): Official Huawei news, announcements, and media releases.
- [Sustainability](https://www.huawei.com/en/sustainability): Corporate sustainability strategy, reports, and environmental initiatives.
- [Trust Center](https://www.huawei.com/en/trust-center): Security, privacy, compliance, and trust-related corporate resources.

## Consumer Products
- [Consumer Homepage](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/): Main consumer portal for Huawei devices, software, and services.
- [Smartphones](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/phones/): Huawei smartphone lineup, product details, and feature highlights.
- [Laptops](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/laptops/): Huawei PC and laptop products for personal and professional use.
- [Tablets](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/tablets/): Huawei tablet devices, specifications, and ecosystem features.
- [Wearables](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/wearables/): Smartwatches, bands, and health-focused wearable devices.
- [Audio](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/audio/): Earbuds, headphones, speakers, and related audio accessories.
- [Routers](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/routers/): Consumer networking devices including routers and home connectivity products.
- [Accessories Overview](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/accessories/overview/): Accessory catalog for Huawei consumer devices and ecosystem products.

## Consumer Software and Support
- [EMUI](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/emui-13/): Consumer software experience page for Huawei’s EMUI platform.
- [Support Homepage](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/support/): Consumer support portal for troubleshooting, manuals, and service help.
- [Downloads](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/support/content/en-us15825330/): Software and utility downloads for supported consumer devices.
- [Warranty Policy](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/support/warranty-policy/): Warranty terms and after-sales policy information for consumer products.
- [Repair Service](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/support/repair/): Device repair options, service processes, and support guidance.
- [Service Center](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/support/service-center/): Locate authorized Huawei service centers and support locations.
- [HUAWEI Community](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/community/): Community discussions, tips, announcements, and user engagement resources.

## Enterprise Solutions
- [Huawei Enterprise Homepage](https://e.huawei.com/en/): Enterprise portal for products, solutions, services, and industry use cases.
- [Enterprise Networking](https://e.huawei.com/en/solutions/enterprise-network): Enterprise network solutions for campus, branch, and data center environments.
- [Enterprise Optical Network](https://e.huawei.com/en/solutions/enterprise-optical-network): Optical networking solutions for enterprise connectivity and transmission.
- [Enterprise Wireless](https://e.huawei.com/en/solutions/enterprise-wireless): Wireless LAN and enterprise mobility solutions for business environments.
- [Data Storage](https://e.huawei.com/en/products/storage): Enterprise storage systems and data infrastructure offerings.
- [Datacom](https://e.huawei.com/en/products/datacom): Data communication products including switches, routers, and campus networking.
- [Intelligent Collaboration](https://e.huawei.com/en/products/intelligent-collaboration): Collaboration hardware and smart office communication solutions.
- [Enterprise Support](https://support.huawei.com/enterprise/en/index.html): Technical support portal for enterprise products, documentation, and service tools.

## Carrier Network
- [Carrier Business Homepage](https://carrier.huawei.com/en/): Carrier-focused portal for telecom network products, solutions, and transformation topics.
- [Wireless Network](https://carrier.huawei.com/en/products/wireless-network): Mobile network infrastructure products and wireless access technologies.
- [Fixed Network](https://carrier.huawei.com/en/products/fixed-network): Fixed broadband and access network solutions for telecom operators.
- [Optical Network](https://carrier.huawei.com/en/products/optical-network): Optical transport and transmission products for carrier networks.
- [Core Network](https://carrier.huawei.com/en/products/core-network): Core network technologies supporting mobile and converged services.
- [Software](https://carrier.huawei.com/en/products/software): Carrier software platforms for operations, orchestration, and service enablement.
- [Services](https://carrier.huawei.com/en/services): Professional and lifecycle services for telecom operators.
- [Insights](https://carrier.huawei.com/en/insights): Carrier industry trends, white papers, and strategic thought leadership.

## Huawei Cloud
- [Huawei Cloud Homepage](https://www.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/): Cloud services portal for infrastructure, AI, databases, and developer tools.
- [Product Documentation](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/): Central documentation hub for Huawei Cloud products and services.
- [API Explorer](https://apiexplorer.huaweicloud.com/apiexplorer/): Interactive API reference and testing interface for Huawei Cloud services.
- [Developer Center](https://developer.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/): Developer resources, SDKs, tools, and learning materials.
- [Cloud Marketplace](https://marketplace.huaweicloud.com/intl/): Marketplace for third-party and Huawei Cloud solutions.
- [Help Center](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/usermanual-help-center/helpcenter_01_0001.html): Help center for account, billing, and service usage guidance.
- [Training and Certification](https://edu.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/): Cloud learning, training, and certification programs.

## Developer and Open Ecosystem
- [Huawei Developers](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/): Developer portal for Huawei consumer ecosystem, HMS, and app integration.
- [HMS Core Overview](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/hms): Overview of Huawei Mobile Services capabilities and developer offerings.
- [Documentation](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/doc/): Technical documentation for Huawei developer platforms and APIs.
- [API References](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/doc/development): API and integration references for Huawei developer services.
- [Downloads](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/download/): SDKs, tools, IDE plugins, and development resources.
- [AppGallery Connect](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/service/josp/agc/index.html): App lifecycle, analytics, testing, and distribution platform for developers.
- [HUAWEI DevEco Studio](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/deveco-studio/): Development environment for Huawei ecosystem application creation.

## Support and Technical Resources
- [Enterprise Support Portal](https://support.huawei.com/enterprise/en/index.html): Product support, manuals, software, and troubleshooting for enterprise customers.
- [Enterprise Documentation](https://support.huawei.com/enterprise/en/doc/EDOC1100000000): Enterprise technical documentation and product manuals.
- [Software Download Center](https://support.huawei.com/enterprise/en/software): Enterprise software downloads, patches, and version resources.
- [Technical Forums](https://forum.huawei.com/enterprise/en/index.html): Community forum for enterprise technical discussions and problem solving.
- [Consumer Support](https://consumer.huawei.com/en/support/): End-user support for Huawei consumer devices and services.
- [Cloud Support](https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/): Documentation and support resources for Huawei Cloud users.

## Insights, News, and Research
- [Huawei News](https://www.huawei.com/en/news): Official corporate news and press releases.
- [Industry Insights](https://www.huawei.com/en/industry-insights): Articles and perspectives on digital transformation across industries.
- [Publications](https://www.huawei.com/en/publications): Reports, white papers, and strategic publications from Huawei.
- [Events](https://www.huawei.com/en/events): Huawei conferences, summits, and event information.
- [Carrier Insights](https://carrier.huawei.com/en/insights): Telecom-focused analysis, trends, and transformation viewpoints.
- [Enterprise Success Stories](https://e.huawei.com/en/success-stories): Customer stories and enterprise deployment case studies.
- [Huawei Cloud Blog](https://www.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/blogs/): Cloud product updates, tutorials, and technical articles.
